# Declare docs

The Declare reference, rendered AS a Declare app — self-hosted: Declare
documenting Declare. It loads docs-model.json — the extractor's output
(tools/internal/doc/extract.mjs), one walkable data structure — and renders a
navigable class reference: a left rail of components, a detail pane with each
class's Markdown prose and an attributes table, every doc string rendered by
the runtime Markdown component. This one app is both the in-browser docs and
(once built) the web docs; the live object browser is this same view reached
from an instance.

`{ }` bodies are TypeScript → `0x…` colors and expressions; `[ ]` literal
slots take `#…` / named colors. Every color reads `theme.<token>` — one
prevailing record on the App (see it there), so the whole document reskins
from one place.

segments.html:
use [ SunIcon, AutoIcon, MoonIcon ]

font Sans [ family = "system-ui" ]

font Code [ family = "ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace" ]   // matches the runtime house code face (PROSE.mono)

segments.md:
## Type tokens

Selection is a PREVAILING slot: these tokens don't opt in themselves — the
detail pane sets `selectable = true` on its container, so all right-pane text
(including Markdown prose) is selectable, while the left rail stays
unselectable chrome.

segments.html:
class Title extends Text [ fontFamily = [Sans, "system-ui", "sans-serif"],
    fontWeight = semibold, textColor = { theme.text }
    ]


class Muted extends Text [ fontFamily = [Sans, "system-ui", "sans-serif"],
    textColor = { theme.textMuted }
    ]


class Mono extends Text [ fontFamily = [Code, "ui-monospace", "monospace"] ]

// a component tab in the left rail — selection is one App attribute
// (`app.selected`, the class name); a tab lights when it matches and sets it
// on click, so the whole navigator is one string

class ClassTab extends View [ width = { parent.width }, height = 32, cornerRadius = 6,
    cname:   string = "",
    fill = { app.selected == classroot.cname ? theme.sel : hovered ? theme.control : null },
    onClick()     { app.refAt = classroot.cname; app.location = "reference/" + classroot.cname; app.showPage() },
    lbl: Mono [ x = 12, y = 8, fontSize = 14, wrap = false,
        text = { classroot.cname },
        textColor = { app.selected == classroot.cname ? theme.text : theme.tabIdle } ]
    ]

segments.md:
## The reference kit

The chips, links, rows, and strips a class page is built from. A chip is a
member name in a tinted pill — attribute teal, method blue, event amber, class
accent — and a class chip is a LINK: a location write, exactly as a rail tab.
Every row of mixed type is a baseline row (`align = baseline`), and every
composite in one CLAIMS its baseline.

segments.html:
class Eyebrow extends Mono [ fontSize = { 11 * app.fontScale }, letterSpacing = 1.2, wrap = false,
    textColor = { theme.eyebrow }
    ]


// a section: a rule above, the heading, one line on what the section holds

class SectionHead extends View [ width = { parent.width },
    head: string = "",
    note: string = "",
    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 18 ],
    rule: View [ width = { parent.width }, height = 1, fill = { theme.line } ],
    title: View [ width = { parent.width },
        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 4 ],
        Title [ fontSize = { 20 * app.fontScale }, text = { classroot.head } ],
        Muted [ fontSize = { 14 * app.fontScale }, width = { parent.width }, text = { classroot.note } ]
        ]
    ]


class Chip extends View [ height = { 24 * app.fontScale }, cornerRadius = 6,
    baseline: number = { this.lbl.y + this.lbl.baseline },
    label: string = "",
    kind:  "attribute" | "method" | "event" | "class" | "token" = "attribute",
    cls:   string = "",
    width = { this.lbl.width + 16 },
    fill = { hovered && cls != "" ? theme.chipHov
           : kind == "method" ? theme.mchipBg
           : kind == "event"  ? theme.echipBg
           : theme.chipBg },
    cursor = { cls != "" ? "pointer" : "default" },
    link = { cls != "" ? "#reference/" + cls : "" },
    onClick() { if (cls != "") { app.refAt = cls; app.location = "reference/" + cls; app.showPage() } },
    lbl: Mono [ x = 8, y = { 5 * app.fontScale }, fontSize = { 13 * app.fontScale }, wrap = false,
        text = { classroot.label },
        textColor = { classroot.kind == "class"  ? theme.accent
                    : classroot.kind == "method" ? theme.chipBlue
                    : classroot.kind == "event"  ? theme.chipAmber
                    : classroot.kind == "token"  ? theme.code
                    : theme.chipTeal } ]
    ]


// one step of the ancestry: `→` before every ancestor but the first, then its chip

class Link extends View [
    baseline: number = { this.chip.y + this.chip.baseline },
    width = { this.contentWidth },
    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 8, align = baseline ],
    arrow: Mono [ fontSize = { 14 * app.fontScale }, visible = { :arrow }, textColor = { theme.sigDim }, text = "→" ],
    chip:  Chip [ kind = "class", cls = { "" + :name }, label = { "" + :name } ]
    ]


// a section link in the row under the opener: the section's name, its count, and
// the scroll — for the reader who came for a fact and will not scroll to reach it

class JumpLink extends View [
    baseline: number = { this.row.y + this.row.name.y + this.row.name.baseline },
    label: string = "",
    count: number = 0,
    to: View = null,
    height = { 28 * app.fontScale }, cornerRadius = 7, cursor = "pointer",
    width = { this.row.width + 24 },
    fill = { hovered ? theme.chipHov : theme.chipBg },
    onClick() { if (to != null) to.scrollIntoView() },
    row: View [ x = 12, y = { 5 * app.fontScale }, width = { this.contentWidth }, height = { 18 * app.fontScale },
        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 6, align = baseline ],
        name: Text [ fontFamily = [Sans, "system-ui", "sans-serif"], fontSize = { 13 * app.fontScale }, fontWeight = semibold, wrap = false,
            textColor = { theme.accent }, text = { classroot.label } ],
        n: Mono [ fontSize = { 12 * app.fontScale }, wrap = false, textColor = { theme.sigDim }, text = { "" + classroot.count } ]
        ]
    ]

segments.md:
## The wrapping chip

A chip in an inherited strip is a RUN OF WORDS, each word its own tinted box,
abutting — invisibly one chip while it fits. When the label is wider than the
column the chip takes the whole width and its words wrap inside it, the
continuation rows stepped in by the run's `hangingIndent`. Rounding is the
run's: its first word rounds on the left, its last on the right, every other
edge — a row's cut included — runs square, as an inline code span breaks
across lines. (A single word wider than the column still overflows; breaking
inside a word is the text engine's, not a flow's.)

segments.html:
class WrapChip extends View [
    kind:  "attribute" | "method" | "event" = "attribute",
    cls:   string = "",
    label: string = "",
    n:     number = { app.wordsOf(label).length },

    // wider than the column? then the chip is the column, and its words wrap

    long:  boolean = { this.probe.width + 16 > parent.width },
    width  = { long ? parent.width : this.run.contentWidth },
    height = { this.run.contentHeight },
    cursor = "pointer",
    link = { "#reference/" + cls },
    onClick() { app.refAt = cls; app.location = "reference/" + cls; app.showPage() },
    probe: Mono [ visible = false, fontSize = { 13 * app.fontScale }, wrap = false, text = { classroot.label } ],
    words: Dataset [ contents = { ({ items: app.wordsOf(classroot.label) }) } ],   // the words as DECLARED data — a cursor root

    // the run's width never comes from the chip (whose width follows the run's
    // content — a cycle): the column when long, else unbounded, pointer-transparent

    run: View [ width = { classroot.long ? classroot.parent.width : 100000 }, pointerEvents = "none",
        datapath = { classroot.words.value },
        layout: WrappingLayout [ spacing = 0, lineSpacing = 4, hangingIndent = 24 ],
        View [ datapath = :items[], height = { 24 * app.fontScale },
            first: boolean = { this.$data("i") == 0 },
            last:  boolean = { this.$data("i") == classroot.n - 1 },
            width = { this.t.width + (first ? 8 : 0) + (last ? 8 : 0) },
            cornerRadius = { [first ? 6 : 0, last ? 6 : 0, last ? 6 : 0, first ? 6 : 0] },
            fill = { classroot.hovered ? theme.chipHov
                   : classroot.kind == "method" ? theme.mchipBg
                   : classroot.kind == "event"  ? theme.echipBg
                   : theme.chipBg },
            t: Mono [ x = { parent.first ? 8 : 0 }, y = { 5 * app.fontScale }, fontSize = { 13 * app.fontScale }, wrap = false,
                text = { "" + this.$data("w") },
                textColor = { classroot.kind == "method" ? theme.chipBlue
                            : classroot.kind == "event"  ? theme.chipAmber
                            : theme.chipTeal } ]
            ]
        ]
    ]

segments.md:
## Reference rows

One row per documented member. `AttrRow` is an attribute: the signature line
(name : type = default), a long or multi-line default on its own indented line,
the prevailing / read-only badges, the OVERRIDE line when the class re-defaults
an inherited slot (the ancestor's slot as a link, and what its default was
there), then its prose — for an override, the INTENT. `MethodRow` and
`EventRow` are the method and event forms.

segments.html:
class OverrideLine extends View [ width = { parent.width },
    from:  string = "",
    slot:  string = "",
    was:   string = "",
    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 8, align = baseline ],
    Muted [ fontSize = { 13 * app.fontScale }, text = "overrides" ],
    Chip [ kind = "class", cls = { classroot.from }, label = { classroot.from + "." + classroot.slot } ],
    Mono [ fontSize = { 13 * app.fontScale }, textColor = { theme.sigDim }, visible = { classroot.was != "" },
        text = { "was = " + classroot.was } ]
    ]


class AttrRow extends View [ width = { parent.width },
    aname: string = { :name },
    live:  boolean = false,                 // page-active, threaded down to any inline island

    // a long or multi-line `{ … }` default leaves the signature line and sits on its
    // own, indented — a signature is never truncated and never scrolls

    long: boolean = { ("" + (:default ?? "")).length > 44 || ("" + (:default ?? "")).indexOf("\n") >= 0 },
    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 6 ],

    sig: View [ width = { parent.width },
        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 8, align = baseline ],
        Mono [ fontSize = { 15 * app.fontScale }, fontWeight = semibold, textColor = { theme.text }, text = { :name } ],
        Mono [ fontSize = { 15 * app.fontScale }, textColor = { theme.accentSecondary }, text = { ": " + :type } ],
        Mono [ fontSize = { 14 * app.fontScale }, textColor = { theme.sigDim }, visible = { !classroot.long },
            text = { :default != null ? "= " + :default : "" } ]
        ],
    longDefault: Mono [ x = 24, width = { parent.width - 24 }, fontSize = { 13 * app.fontScale }, lineHeight = 1.45, textColor = { theme.sigDim },
        visible = { classroot.long }, text = { "= " + ("" + :default).split("\n").join("\n  ") } ],

    flags: Mono [ fontSize = { 12 * app.fontScale }, textColor = { theme.eyebrow },
        visible = { :prevailing || :readOnly },
        text = { [:prevailing ? "prevailing" : "", :readOnly ? "read-only" : ""].filter(Boolean).join("  ·  ") } ],

    OverrideLine [ visible = { :overrides != null }, from = { "" + :overrides.from }, slot = { "" + :name },
        was = { :overrides.was != null ? "" + :overrides.was : "" } ],

    Block [ datapath = :docSegs[], width = { parent.width },
        live = { classroot.live }, tone = { theme.refDim }, lead = 1.6 ]
    ]


// The signature string (`set(path: string, v: unknown): void`) comes whole from
// the model; a `:sig.slice()` would be MIS-READ as a datapath (the `.` extends
// the path), so the datapath values are captured into plain attributes first
// and sliced in JS.

class MethodRow extends View [ width = { parent.width },
    aname:    string = { :name },
    sigfull:  string = { :signature },
    tailtext: string = { this.sigfull.slice(this.aname.length) },   // "(path: …): void"
    live:     boolean = false,
    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 6 ],

    sig: View [ width = { parent.width },
        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 0 ],
        Mono [ fontSize = { 15 * app.fontScale }, fontWeight = semibold, textColor = { theme.text }, text = { classroot.aname } ],
        Mono [ fontSize = { 15 * app.fontScale }, textColor = { theme.mtail }, text = { classroot.tailtext } ]
        ],

    OverrideLine [ visible = { :overrides != null }, from = { "" + :overrides.from }, slot = { :name + "()" }, was = "" ],

    Block [ datapath = :docSegs[], width = { parent.width },
        live = { classroot.live }, tone = { theme.refDim }, lead = 1.6 ]
    ]


class EventRow extends View [ width = { parent.width },
    aname: string = { :name },
    live:  boolean = false,
    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 6 ],

    sig: Mono [ fontSize = { 15 * app.fontScale }, fontWeight = semibold, textColor = { theme.text }, text = { :signature } ],

    Block [ datapath = :docSegs[], width = { parent.width },
        live = { classroot.live }, tone = { theme.refDim }, lead = 1.6 ]
    ]

segments.md:
## The strips

Per ancestor: what the class INHERITS (`Strip` — the disclosure, the class as a
link, the member counts, one baseline row, then its one-line lead; open, a chip
cloud of every name, each a link, never the ancestor's prose) and what it READS
from above of its own (`ReadStrip`, under Provided — present only for an
ancestor that reads something).

segments.html:
class ReadStrip extends View [ width = { parent.width }, cornerRadius = 10, visible = { :n > 0 },
    open:  boolean = false,
    cname: string = { "" + :name },
    fill = { theme.surface }, stroke = { stroke(1, theme.line) },
    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 0 ],
    head: View [ width = { parent.width }, height = 40, cursor = "pointer", cornerRadius = 10,
        fill = { hovered ? theme.chipBg : null },
        onClick() { classroot.open = !classroot.open },
        title: View [ x = 16, y = 10, width = { parent.width - 32 },
            layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 10, align = baseline ],
            Mono [ fontSize = { 15 * app.fontScale }, wrap = false, textColor = { theme.accent }, text = { classroot.open ? "▼" : "▶" } ],
            Muted [ fontSize = { 13 * app.fontScale }, wrap = false, text = "from" ],
            Chip [ kind = "class", cls = { classroot.cname }, label = { classroot.cname } ],
            Mono [ fontSize = { 13 * app.fontScale }, wrap = false, textColor = { theme.sigDim },
                text = { :n + (:n == 1 ? " value" : " values") } ]
            ]
        ],
    body: View [ width = { parent.width }, visible = { classroot.open },
        inner: View [ x = 16, y = 4, width = { parent.width - 32 },
            layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 8 ],
            tokens: View [ width = { parent.width }, visible = { :reads.theme.length > 0 },
                layout: WrappingLayout [ spacing = 6, lineSpacing = 6, align = baseline ],
                Muted [ fontSize = { 13 * app.fontScale }, text = "theme" ],
                Chip [ datapath = :reads.theme[], kind = "token", label = { "theme." + this.$data("") } ]
                ],
            provided: View [ width = { parent.width }, visible = { :reads.provided.length > 0 },
                layout: WrappingLayout [ spacing = 6, lineSpacing = 6, align = baseline ],
                Muted [ fontSize = { 13 * app.fontScale }, text = "provided" ],
                Chip [ datapath = :reads.provided[], kind = "token", label = { "" + this.$data("") } ]
                ],
            pad: View [ width = { parent.width }, height = 8 ]
            ]
        ]
    ]


class Strip extends View [ width = { parent.width }, cornerRadius = 10,
    open:  boolean = false,                    // a declaration default: yields to the click
    cname: string = { "" + :name },
    fill = { theme.surface }, stroke = { stroke(1, theme.line) },
    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 0 ],

    head: View [ width = { parent.width }, cursor = "pointer",
        height = { this.lead.y + this.lead.height + 14 },
        fill = { hovered ? theme.chipBg : null }, cornerRadius = 10,
        onClick() { classroot.open = !classroot.open },
        title: View [ x = 16, y = 12, width = { parent.width - 32 },
            layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = x, spacing = 10, align = baseline ],
            Mono [ fontSize = { 15 * app.fontScale }, wrap = false, textColor = { theme.accent }, text = { classroot.open ? "▼" : "▶" } ],
            Muted [ fontSize = { 13 * app.fontScale }, wrap = false, text = "from" ],
            Chip [ kind = "class", cls = { classroot.cname }, label = { classroot.cname } ],
            Mono [ fontSize = { 13 * app.fontScale }, wrap = false, textColor = { theme.sigDim },
                text = { :attributes.length + " attributes · " + :methods.length + " methods · " + :events.length + " events" } ]
            ],
        lead: Muted [ x = 42, y = { parent.title.y + parent.title.height + 6 }, fontSize = { 13 * app.fontScale }, width = { parent.width - 58 },
            text = { "" + :lead } ]
        ],

    body: View [ width = { parent.width }, visible = { classroot.open },
        inner: View [ x = 16, y = 12, width = { parent.width - 32 },
            layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 10 ],
            attrs: View [ width = { parent.width }, visible = { :attributes.length > 0 },
                layout: WrappingLayout [ spacing = 6, lineSpacing = 6 ],
                WrapChip [ datapath = :attributes[], kind = "attribute", cls = { classroot.cname }, label = { "" + :label } ]
                ],
            methods: View [ width = { parent.width }, visible = { :methods.length > 0 },
                layout: WrappingLayout [ spacing = 6, lineSpacing = 6 ],
                WrapChip [ datapath = :methods[], kind = "method", cls = { classroot.cname }, label = { "" + :label } ]
                ],
            events: View [ width = { parent.width }, visible = { :events.length > 0 },
                layout: WrappingLayout [ spacing = 6, lineSpacing = 6 ],
                WrapChip [ datapath = :events[], kind = "event", cls = { classroot.cname }, label = { "" + :label } ]
                ],
            pad: View [ width = { parent.width }, height = 8 ]
            ]
        ]
    ]

segments.md:
## The live example

An editable source field beside a running preview — the SAME machinery as the
homepage's editable demos: a `TextInput` seeded from the demo source that
republishes edits on `app.liveSource`, and an `AppIsland` the host mounts
the compiled child app into. Both are keyed by the CLASS NAME: the editor
seeds from `app.demoSources[<Class>]` (the server populates this from
apps/docs/demos/), and the island's `program = <Class>` is what the host
wires.

segments.html:
class DocField extends TextInput [ multiline = true, spellcheck = false, wrap = false,
    fontFamily = [Code, "ui-monospace", "monospace"], fontSize = { 13 * app.fontScale }, textColor = { theme.code },   // 13 = the house code size (PROSE.codeSize)
    editName: string = "",
    src: string = "",

    // Seed the field from the demo source once the subtree exists. (TextInput's
    // `initial` yielding-seed can't be used here: its attach-time guard fires
    // before this field's datapath-sourced `src` constraint is bound, so the seed
    // is skipped. An `onInit` write lands after the model has resolved `src`, and —
    // being an author write, not a constraint — leaves the field freely editable.)

    onInit() { text = src },
    onInput() { app.liveCard = editName; app.liveSource = text }
    ]


// Rendered by datapath replication over the class's 0-or-1 `example` array, so the
// whole island (editor + preview) is CONSTRUCTED only for classes that ship a demo.

class Example extends View [ width = { parent.width },
    cname:  string = { :name },
    elines: number = { :lines },
    esrc:   string = { :source },
    estage: number = { :stageH || 250 },   // extractor-measured stage height — the frame FITS the settled app
    live:   boolean = false,             // the parent gates the preview: it mounts only when this is true

    // this island's edit failed to compile (host publishes the report; see RunIsland)

    broken: boolean = { app.liveCard == cname && app.liveReport != "" },
    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 0 ],   // the preview frame abuts the code block below, no gap

    // the example's own title and lead (from the demo file's opening comment)

    head: View [ width = { parent.width },
        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 6 ],
        Title [ fontSize = { 16 * app.fontScale }, text = { "" + :title } ],
        lead: Markdown [ width = { parent.width }, visible = { ("" + :lead) != "" }, lineHeight = 1.55,
            bodyColor = { theme.refDim }, scale = { app.fontScale }, dark = { app.darkUI }, text = { "" + :lead } ],
        gap: View [ height = 6 ]
        ],

    // the editable source card — coheres with a static code block (the same
    // `chipBg` tint, 8px radius, 13px code face) but is marked LIVE/EDITABLE by an
    // AMBER left bar + label, where a read-only block carries the teal `codeRule`.

    panel: View [ width = { parent.width }, fill = { theme.chipBg },
        height = { Math.min(classroot.elines * 15 * app.fontScale + 105, 900) },   // 15px/line measured; field pad + 60/8 chrome
        bar:   View [ x = 0, y = 0, width = 3, height = { parent.height }, fill = { classroot.broken ? theme.errBar : 0xE6B450 } ],
        fname: Mono [ x = 18, y = 10, fontSize = { 11 * app.fontScale }, fontWeight = semibold, textColor = { theme.strong },
            text = { classroot.cname + ".declare" } ],

        // the marker is an INVERTED chip — the amber accent as fill, black letters —
        // so "live/editable" reads at a glance, distinct from a read-only block

        tag:   View [ y = 7, height = 17, cornerRadius = 3, fill = 0xE6B450, x = { parent.width - this.width - 14 },
            lbl: Mono [ x = 7, y = 3, fontSize = 10, letterSpacing = 1, fontWeight = semibold, textColor = 0x1A1A1A,
                text = "LIVE · EDITABLE", wrap = false ],
            width = { this.lbl.width + 14 }
            ],

        // Revert — restore the pristine source and republish (see RunIsland)

        rev: View [ y = 5, height = 20, cornerRadius = 6, stroke = { stroke(1, theme.line) },
            x = { parent.tag.x - this.width - 10 },
            width = { this.rlbl.width + 16 },
            fill = { hovered ? theme.control : null },
            onClick() { classroot.panel.field.text = classroot.esrc
                        app.liveCard = classroot.cname
                        app.liveSource = classroot.esrc },
            rlbl: Text [ x = 8, y = 3, fontFamily = [Sans, "system-ui", "sans-serif"], fontSize = 11, fontWeight = semibold,
                textColor = { parent.hovered ? theme.text : theme.textMuted }, text = "Revert" ]
            ],

        // a line of breathing room below the label before the code starts

        hair:  View [ x = 18, y = 51, width = { parent.width - 30 }, height = 1, fill = { theme.line } ],
        field: DocField [ x = 18, y = 60, width = { parent.width - 30 }, height = { parent.height - 68 },
            editName = { classroot.cname }, src = { classroot.esrc } ]
        ],

    // the compile report at the island (see RunIsland — same teaching surface)

    err: View [ width = { parent.width }, fill = { theme.errBg },
        visible = { classroot.broken },
        height = { this.msg.height + 20 },
        bar: View [ x = 0, y = 0, width = 3, height = { parent.height }, fill = { theme.errBar } ],
        msg: Text [ x = 18, y = 10, width = { parent.width - 36 }, wrap = true,
            fontFamily = [Code, "ui-monospace", "monospace"], fontSize = { 12 * app.fontScale },
            textColor = { theme.errText }, text = { app.liveReport } ]
        ],

    // the live preview island — the host mounts the compiled child app here. The slot
    // is live ONLY while the parent says so (`live`), so exactly one preview (the one
    // on the visible page) compiles at a time, even though every page is constructed.

    stage: View [ width = { parent.width }, height = { classroot.estage }, fill = { theme.chipBg },
        run:     AppIsland [ width = { parent.width }, height = { parent.height },
            program = { classroot.live ? classroot.cname : "" } ],

        // a blue rule (a darker shade of the chipBg box tint) divides the code above from the
        // running app below; the gold spine (drawn OVER both) continues the code's gold left bar
        // down the preview, same x/width

        divider: View [ x = 0, y = 0, width = { parent.width }, height = 2, fill = { theme.rule } ],
        spine:   View [ x = 0, y = 0, width = 3, height = { parent.height }, fill = 0xE6B450 ]
        ]
    ]

segments.md:
## Inline examples, woven through the prose

Every `declare` code fence in any prose that compiles (as-is, or wrapped in
`App […]`) becomes a `RunIsland`: the source above, its live preview below —
edit and it re-runs. The extractor wrote its source to
`apps/docs/demos/<id>.declare`, so the host seeds and mounts it exactly
like the homepage's demos. `live` (threaded from the page) keeps the
preview's slot empty until its page is the one on screen, so only the visible
page's islands ever compile.

segments.html:
class RunIsland extends View [ width = { parent.width },
    rid:    string  = { :id },
    rsrc:   string  = { :source },
    rlines: number  = { :lines },
    rstage: number  = { :stageH || 200 },   // extractor-measured stage height — the frame FITS the settled app
    live:   boolean = false,

    // this island's edit is the one that failed to compile — the host publishes the
    // report on app.liveReport (cleared by a clean compile), keyed by app.liveCard

    broken: boolean = { app.liveCard == rid && app.liveReport != "" },
    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 0 ],   // the preview frame abuts the code block, no gap

    // marked live/editable by the amber bar + label (a read-only block is teal).

    // padding and the 46+8 header/footer chrome — so the code fits without an
    // inner scrollbar up to the cap

    editor: View [ width = { parent.width }, fill = { theme.chipBg },
        height = { Math.min(classroot.rlines * 15 * app.fontScale + 93, 900) },

        tag:  View [ x = 18, y = 7, height = 17, cornerRadius = 3, fill = 0xE6B450,

                text = "LIVE · EDITABLE", wrap = false ],
            width = { this.lbl.width + 14 }
            ],

        // Revert restores the pristine source and republishes it — the way back the
        // guide owes a reader it just told to break something

        rev: View [ y = 5, height = 20, cornerRadius = 6, stroke = { stroke(1, theme.line) },
            x = { parent.width - this.width - 10 },
            width = { this.rlbl.width + 16 },
            fill = { hovered ? theme.control : null },

                        app.liveCard = classroot.rid

        // a line of breathing room below the label before the code starts

        field: DocField [ x = 18, y = 46, width = { parent.width - 30 }, height = { parent.height - 54 },
            editName = { classroot.rid }, src = { classroot.rsrc } ]
        ],

    // the compile report, at the island — the diagnostic is a teaching surface, so a
    // broken edit shows its error right here (the last good render stays below it)

    err: View [ width = { parent.width }, fill = { theme.errBg },
        visible = { classroot.broken },
        height = { this.msg.height + 20 },

        msg: Text [ x = 18, y = 10, width = { parent.width - 36 }, wrap = true,

        ],

## The guide

The mode switch, the chapter rail, and a chapter page. The doc app is two
views over one model: a narrative GUIDE and the class REFERENCE. `app.mode`
picks which; each keeps its own selection (`app.chapter` / `app.selected`) so
switching back lands where you left.

segments.html:
// The mode switch is a full-width segmented pair — each tab half the rail, label
// centered — so the rail's primary control reads at the rail's own (fixed) type
// size. Nav chrome does NOT ride app.fontScale: the A-stepper is a reading-comfort
// control for the content pane; the rail keeps its designed sizes.


// one chapter link in the guide rail — lights when it is the current chapter

class ChapterTab extends View [ width = { parent.width }, height = 32, cornerRadius = 6,
    cid: string = { :id },
    cnum: number = { :num },
    ctitle: string = { :short },
    fill = { app.chapter == classroot.cid ? theme.sel : hovered ? theme.control : null },
    onClick()     { app.guideAt = classroot.cid; app.location = "guide/" + classroot.cid; app.showPage() },

    // numbered, because the chapters cite each other by number ("chapter 3")

    lbl: Text [ x = 12, y = 8, fontFamily = [Sans, "system-ui", "sans-serif"], fontSize = 14, wrap = false,
        text = { classroot.cnum + ". " + classroot.ctitle },
        textColor = { app.chapter == classroot.cid ? theme.text : theme.tabIdle } ]
    ]


// one Part in the guide rail — an eyebrow over that part's chapter links

class PartGroup extends View [ width = { parent.width },
    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 3 ],
    p: string = { :part },
    g:       View [ height = 14 ],
    eyebrow: Mono [ fontSize = 12, letterSpacing = 1.4, fontWeight = semibold, textColor = { theme.textMuted }, text = { classroot.p.toUpperCase() } ],
    g2:      View [ height = 4 ],
    ChapterTab [ datapath = :chapters[] ]
    ]


// one chapter page — the chapter as ordered segments (prose + inline runnable islands),
// then its optional flagship demo. Every ```declare block that compiles is a live island.

class ChapterDetail extends View [ width = { parent.width },
    cid: string = { :id },
    visible = { app.mode == "guide" && app.chapter == classroot.cid },
    pageLive: boolean = { app.mode == "guide" && app.chapter == classroot.cid },
    layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 20 ],

    // The chapter's content is its OWN file (chapters/<id>.json — the
    // extractor's per-chapter projection), fetched WHEN VISIBILITY REQUIRES
    // IT, not at construction (ruled 2026-08-08; the eager prefetch made every
    // boot — and every crawl location — pay the whole corpus). `wanted` is a
    // latch: the page being on screen asks for the file, and `loaded` holds
    // the url steady afterward, so a chapter stays RESIDENT once landed —
    // switches are instant on return, and nothing ever refetches. A boot
    // costs the model plus exactly one chapter; the other 21 shells stay
    // empty until walked to. The crawl pulls only the location's own chapter

The model stays NORMALIZED — inherited members are never copied into

    ancestryOf(name: string) -> array {
        const me = app.classNode(name) as any

        },

    ancestorsOf(name: string) -> array {
        const me = app.classNode(name) as any
        if (me == null) return []
        return me.chain.slice(1).map((id) => app.classNode(id) as any).filter((c) => c != null).map((c) => ({
            name: c.name, lead: app.plainLead(c.doc || ""),
            reads: c.reads || ({ theme: [], provided: [] }),
            n: c.reads ? c.reads.theme.length + c.reads.provided.length : 0,
            attributes: c.attributes.map((a) => ({ name: a.name, label: a.name + ": " + a.type })),
            methods: c.methods.map((m) => ({ name: m.name, label: m.signature })),
            events: c.events.map((e) => ({ name: e.name, label: e.signature })) }))
        },

    // the first paragraph of a class's prose, as plain text — a strip's one-line lead

    plainLead(md: string) -> string {
        return md.split("\n\n")[0].replace(/\n/g, " ").replace(/\*\*/g, "").replace(/\u0060/g, "").replace(/\*/g, "").replace(/\s*\(docs\/system-design[^)]*\)/g, "").trim()
        },

    hasOverrides(list: array) -> boolean { return (list || []).some((a) => a.overrides != null) },

    // a label's words, each keeping its trailing space, so a run of word chips reads continuously

    wordsOf(label: string) -> array {
        const ws = ("" + label).match(/\S+\s*/g) || [label]
        return ws.map((w, i) => ({ i: i, w: w }))
        },

    findDocs(q: string, idx: object) -> array {
        const query = ("" + q).trim().toLowerCase()
        const entries = idx != null ? (idx as any).entries : null
        if (query == "" || entries == null) return []
        const terms = query.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)
        const out = []
        for (const e of entries) {
            const tl = e.title.toLowerCase(), xl = e.text.toLowerCase()
            let score = 0, first = -1, ok = true
            for (const t of terms) {
                const ti = tl.indexOf(t), xi = xl.indexOf(t)
                if (ti < 0 && xi < 0) { ok = false; break }
                if (ti >= 0) score += ti == 0 ? 120 : 50
                if (xi >= 0) { score += 10; if (first < 0 || xi < first) first = xi }
            }
            if (!ok) continue
            let snip = ""
            if (first >= 0) {
                let a = Math.max(0, first - 70), b = Math.min(e.text.length, first + 130)

                for (const t of terms) {
                    const safe = t.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&")
                    snip = snip.replace(new RegExp(safe, "ig"), (m) => "**" + m + "**")
                }

            out.push({ loc: e.loc, title: e.title, crumb: e.crumb, snip: snip, score: score, i: 0 })
        }

        for (let i = 0; i < top.length; i++) top[i].i = i   // the row's index — keyboard walk + selection highlight key on it
        return top

            SizeBtn [ glyph = 19, delta = 0.1 ]
            ],

        themeSwitch: Segmented [ y = { (app.barH - 30) / 2 }, x = { app.hostWidth - 96 - 16 },
            height = 30, width = 96, iconSize = 15,
            value = { app.themeMode },
            input(v: object) { app.themeMode = "" + v },
            choices = { [ ({ id: "light",  icon: "SunIcon" }),
                          ({ id: "system", icon: "AutoIcon" }),
                          ({ id: "dark",   icon: "MoonIcon" }) ] }
            ]
        ],

segments.md:
## The left rail
Below the bar: the Guide/Reference switch, then the nav for the live
mode. (Brand and the display controls live in the bar now.)

segments.html:
rail: View [ x = 0, y = { app.barH }, width = { app.railW }, height = { app.hostHeight - app.barH }, scrolls = y, fill = { theme.rail },
        edge: View [ x = { app.railW - 1 }, y = 0, width = 1, height = { parent.height }, fill = { theme.edge } ],
        col: View [ x = 16, y = 16, width = { app.railW - 32 },
            layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 4 ],

            // Guide / Reference. This was a segmented control in every respect
            // except being one: two hand-styled `View`s, so no focus, no tab
            // stop, no keyboard, no press state (register D10). The delivery
            // seam already fit — the pair's value is `app.mode`, deriving from
            // `app.location`, so a pick writes the location and the value comes
            // back round, which is the single source of truth the location
            // comment above asks for.

            modes: Segmented [ width = { parent.width }, height = 30,
                value = { app.mode },
                input(v: object) {
                    app.location = ("" + v) == "guide" ? "guide/" + app.guideAt
                                 : ("" + v) == "language" ? "language/" + app.formAt
                                 : "reference/" + app.refAt
                    app.showPage()
                    },

                // each half declares WHERE it goes, so the switch is a link the
                // crawler can follow — without it the reference half of the docs
                // is unreachable from the default location (see SegmentedItem)

                choices = { [ ({ id: "guide",     label: "Guide",     location: "guide/" + app.guideAt }),
                              ({ id: "reference", label: "Reference", location: "reference/" + app.refAt }),
                              ({ id: "language",  label: "Language",  location: "language/" + app.formAt }) ] }
                ],

            // guide nav — parts and their chapters

            guideNav: View [ width = { parent.width }, visible = { app.mode == "guide" },
                layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 2 ],
                PartGroup [ datapath = :guideParts[] ]
                ],

            // reference nav — the component list

            langNav: View [ width = { parent.width }, visible = { app.mode == "language" },
                layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 2 ],
                g1: View [ height = 14 ],
                idx: View [ width = { parent.width }, height = 28, cornerRadius = 6,
                    fill = { app.form == "" ? theme.sel : hovered ? theme.control : null },
                    link = "#language/",
                    onClick() { app.formAt = ""; app.location = "language/"; app.showPage() },
                    Mono [ x = 12, y = 6, fontSize = 13, wrap = false, text = "All forms", textColor = { app.form == "" ? theme.text : theme.tabIdle } ]
                    ],
                FormGroup [ datapath = :forms.groups[] ]
                ],

            refNav: View [ width = { parent.width }, visible = { app.mode == "reference" },
                layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 4 ],
                g1:    View [ height = 14 ],
                eyebrow: Mono [ fontSize = 12, letterSpacing = 1.4, fontWeight = semibold, textColor = { theme.textMuted }, text = "COMPONENTS" ],
                g2:    View [ height = 4 ],
                ClassTab [ datapath = :tree[], cname = :name ]
                ]
            ]
        ],

segments.md:
## The detail pane
Its own scroller. Guide chapters are light shells (each fetches and
builds its content only once visibility asks — ChapterDetail); the
reference is ONE page, re-rooted to the selection (refCol). So the
scroller only ever measures what is actually being read.
`selectable` (prevailing) opts the whole right pane into ordinary
browser text selection — prose, signatures, Markdown runs — while the
rail stays chrome.

SEARCH REPLACES THE CONTENT (ruled 2026-08-08): while the query is
non-empty the reading column hides and the results page takes the pane
— same column, same scroller, no overlay chrome. Clearing the query
(Escape, opening a result, deleting the text) brings the page back
exactly as it was: `visible` conceals, it never tears down. No matches
(or the index still loading) says so in the middle of the pane.

segments.html:
detail: View [ x = { app.railW }, y = { app.barH }, width = { app.hostWidth - app.railW }, height = { app.hostHeight - app.barH }, scrolls = y, selectable = true,
        top: View [ x = 0, y = 0, width = 1, height = 1 ],       // showPage's scroll-to-top anchor
        col: View [ x = 48, y = 40, width = { parent.width - 96 }, visible = { app.searchQ == "" },
            guideCol: View [ width = { parent.width }, visible = { app.mode == "guide" },
                ChapterDetail [ datapath = :guide[], cid = :id ]
                ],

segments.md:
ONE reference page exists at a time — the selection's (ruled
2026-08-08). The old shape replicated a ClassDetail per class
(356 fully-built pages, `visible` picking one): construction
paid the whole reference at every boot for one visible page.
The datapath now COMPUTES the selected class's node, so a
switch re-roots this single subtree and builds just that page;
the rail (ClassTab, above) still replicates the full list —
that IS what visibility requires of a navigator.

segments.html:
refCol: View [ width = { parent.width }, visible = { app.mode == "reference" },
                ClassDetail [ datapath = { (app.docs.read(["tree"]) || []).find(c => c.name == app.selected) }, cname = :name ]
                ],

            // the language pane: the index (no cursor) or ONE form's page, re-rooted to
            // the selection exactly as the reference page is

            langCol: View [ width = { parent.width }, visible = { app.mode == "language" },
                FormIndex [ datapath = { app.docs.read(["forms"]) } ],
                FormDetail [ datapath = { ((app.docs.read(["forms", "pages"]) || {}) as any)[app.form] }, slug = { "" + :slug } ]
                ]
            ],

        // the results page — rows replicate off the computed hits (the
        // homepage's value-root + :items[] idiom); focusHit walks these
        // children, so this column is the one place rows live

        searchCol: View [ x = 48, y = 24, width = { parent.width - 96 },
            visible = { app.searchQ != "" && app.searchHits.length > 0 },
            layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 2 ],
            datapath = { app.hits.value },
            SearchHit [ datapath = :items[], width = { parent.width } ]
            ],

        // the empty answer, centered in the pane — visible only once the
        // index has answered (before that, the honest "loading")

        noHits: View [ visible = { app.searchQ != "" && app.searchHits.length == 0 },
            x = 0, y = 0, width = { parent.width }, height = { parent.height },
            msg: Muted [ x = center, y = center, fontSize = 14,
                text = { app.searchIdx.loaded ? "No matches — the corpus has nothing for “" + app.searchQ + "”." : "Loading the search index…" } ]
            ]
        ]
    ]
